name: Docket evidence review
target_basis: Working target; saved event requirements specify a video but no numeric duration limit.

steps.caption: This example uses a real Sepolia transfer and an illustrative invoice.
The invoice stays private. A salted fingerprint identifies it.
Check the receipt and compare the exact recipient and amount.
Attestcoin checks inclusion on Creditcoin. No wallet is needed for this call.
A verified inclusion is separate from a matching payment.
Save what was checked, and what still needs attention.
The public export leaves out invoice text, the salt and review notes.
Share the private bundle only with the reviewer who needs it.
The registry write is shown separately from read-only verification.
